attempted_claim: Let C be a smooth projective complex curve of genus g ≥ 2, let n be a composite integer, and let d be coprime to n. For the stable fixed-determinant, trace-free SL_n Higgs moduli space M_Dol(C, SL_n, d) and the corresponding twisted SL_n character variety M_B(C, SL_n, d), does the nonabelian-Hodge identification induce, for every cohomological degree r and every perverse index k, P_k H^r(M_Dol(C, SL_n, d), Q) = W_{2k} H^r(M_B(C, SL_n, d), Q) = W_{2k+1} H^r(M_B(C, SL_n, d), Q)?
decisive_failure: The investigation was blocked at the Betti-side weight compatibility of the Maulik-Shen endoscopic operator (published as open Question 5.5 of arXiv:2008.08520v5), so the full perverse=weight identity for composite-rank SL_n could not be established. The prime-rank SL_p argument does not transfer because composite endoscopy has rank greater than 1, and no target-adjacent alternative met the originality and Audit bar.
